name: 95648 · Lincoln, CA
findings: ZIP 95648 (Lincoln) has 131 nonprofit organizations. 60 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 54 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95648 (Lincoln) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 95648 (Lincoln) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 37 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 9 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
